title: Concept: Session identifier carried in a URL
description: URL rewriting puts the session credential in every place a URL is stored: history, bookmarks, access logs, analytics and the Referer header sent to third-party assets.
applicability: Legacy servlet applications, mobile deep links and any app server still configured with URL-based session tracking.
risk: Anyone who reads a log, a screenshot or a shared link inherits the session and can act as the customer until it expires.
